description:
Title: OEE

Write a process, that collects relevant information from a machine, and calculated the Overall Equipment Efficiency (OEE).
If the OEE falls below a certain value/percentage, stop the machine and send an email to an engineer.
When the machine is restarted, continue measuring.
When the machine is disconnected, stop the process.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_OEE" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/oee">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_MachineRestarted" name="Machine restarted"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_MachineDisconnected" name="Machine disconnected"/>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_OEE" name="OEE" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_OEE" name="Start OEE measurement"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Merge_Measurement" name="Measurement loop"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CollectData" name="Collect machine data"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CalculateOEE" name="Calculate OEE"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OEE_Check" name="OEE below threshold?" default="Flow_OEE_AtOrAboveThreshold"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_StopMachine" name="Stop machine"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendEmailEngineer" name="Send email to engineer"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_MachineRestarted" name="Machine restarted">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_MachineRestarted" messageRef="Message_MachineRestarted"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_MachineDisconnected" name="Machine disconnected" triggeredByEvent="true">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_MachineDisconnected" name="Machine disconnected" isInterrupting="true">
        <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_MachineDisconnected" messageRef="Message_MachineDisconnected"/>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ProcessStopped" name="Process stopped">
        <bpmn:terminateEventDefinition id="TED_ProcessStopped"/>
      </bpmn:endEvent>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Disconnected_Stop" sourceRef="Start_MachineDisconnected" targetRef="End_ProcessStopped"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Merge" sourceRef="Start_OEE" targetRef="Gateway_Merge_Measurement"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_Collect" sourceRef="Gateway_Merge_Measurement" targetRef="Task_CollectData"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Collect_Calculate" sourceRef="Task_CollectData" targetRef="Task_CalculateOEE"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Calculate_Check" sourceRef="Task_CalculateOEE" targetRef="Gateway_OEE_Check"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OEE_Below" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_OEE_Check" targetRef="Task_StopMachine"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OEE_AtOrAboveThreshold" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_OEE_Check" targetRef="Gateway_Merge_Measurement"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Stop_Email" sourceRef="Task_StopMachine" targetRef="Task_SendEmailEngineer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Email_Wait" sourceRef="Task_SendEmailEngineer" targetRef="Event_MachineRestarted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Restarted_Merge" sourceRef="Event_MachineRestarted" targetRef="Gateway_Merge_Measurement"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
